description: This Java class 'MacroCallParameterMatcher' provides custom matcher functionality for testing macros with specific parameter names and values. It extends TypeSafeMatcher to match entries of a Map keyed by Strings with Object values, to facilitate testing macro parameters in the Ofbiz widget rendering framework.

classes.name: MacroCallParameterMatcher
classes.description: A custom matcher for verifying macro call parameters by name and value, supporting various value types and providing detailed mismatch descriptions.
